title: UI风格#201 - Corporate Memphis (企业孟菲斯)
description: 创建第201种UI风格：企业孟菲斯风格 - 扁平人物、夸张形状、明亮色彩。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planGS.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Corporate Memphis style When color palette Then features bright flat colors, peachy skin, bold backgrounds
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#FF6B6B (珊瑚红), #4ECDC4 (薄荷绿), #FFE66D (阳光黄), #95E1D3 (浅绿)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Corporate Memphis style When typography Then uses friendly sans: Nunito, Quicksand, Poppins
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Nunito (友好), Quicksand (柔和), Poppins (现代)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Corporate Memphis style When layout Then flat illustration style, abstract human figures, blob shapes
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：扁平插画风格、抽象人物、不规则形状

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Corporate Memphis style When UI elements Then bouncy animations, blob backgrounds, flat shadows
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：弹跳动画、不规则背景、扁平阴影

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Corporate Memphis UI When functional Then includes team chat, human agents, teamwork stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：团队聊天、人物代理、协作统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Corporate Memphis UI When copy Then uses team: 'Team', 'Collaborate', 'Together', 'Share'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'TEAM. COLLABORATE. TOGETHER.'、按钮'SUBMIT'→'SHARE'、'DEPLOY'→'UNITE'
